name: Monchique
mandate: PrompTugal.news Monchique: AI and technology in Monchique, a forested mountain municipality where wildfire risk and a small municipal business incubator set the agenda, and what reaches Monchique from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Monchique is a mountain municipality whose public agenda is shaped by forest and wildfire risk. The Serra was badly hit by the fires of 2018, and the research project BRIDGE (IST, LNEC and the University of the Algarve, funded by FCT, 2021 to 2024) used Monchique as its pilot case for community-based fire risk reduction, followed by InnoBRIDGE funded by AGIF. A fire in Marmelete on 25 July 2026 drew nearly a hundred operatives. On the technology side, the council runs a business incubator, and its best-known tenant is Invisible CFO, a fintech whose product uses AI.

ai_news.title: Wider news: the government's APIS pilots bring AI to early fire detection in protected areas, not in Monchique
ai_news.summary: In March 2026 the Environment Ministry created APIS (Áreas Protegidas Inteligentes e Seguras), coordinated by ICNF and funded by the Fundo Ambiental with up to 125,000 euros per site for 2026 and 2027. The two pilots are the Alvão natural park and the Serra do Açor protected landscape, using AI, digitalisation and automation for early detection. The report names neither the Algarve nor Monchique.
ai_news.ai_path: A national AI fire-detection pilot for the same problem that defines Monchique's agenda. If expanded it could reach the Serra, but the pilots are elsewhere.

ai_news.title: Monchique fintech Invisible CFO named a Web Summit Impact Startup for 2025
ai_news.summary: Invisible CFO, founded in 2024 and housed in the Monchique business incubator, was recognised as an Impact Startup 2025, reported as the only Portuguese fintech with that recognition. It combines financial and tax optimisation algorithms and AI with a human team of accountants and advisers, and went to the 2025 summit through the Algarve Empreende 2026 project.
ai_news.ai_path: The startup's own service uses AI in its financial technology layer, and it is based in a Monchique municipal incubator.

ai_news.title: Wider news: Floresta Limpa uses satellite data and machine learning to watch fuel-management strips (not yet in Monchique)
ai_news.summary: A NOVA FCT team (NOVA LINCS) built a platform that reads satellite vegetation indices with machine learning to check regularly whether wildfire fuel-management zones are clear, with an Android app. The app was set up for Almada, Mação and Santarém, with expansion planned. The article does not mention Monchique or the Algarve.
ai_news.ai_path: An AI tool aimed at the exact risk that defines Monchique's agenda, forest fuel and fire, so it is a candidate for the Serra, but we found no sign it is used there.

ai_news.title: Monchique water company says it already uses AI tools, and backs a national AI conference
ai_news.summary: Sociedade da Água de Monchique became the official water partner of the AIVolution conference on AI in organisations. In its own announcement the company says it already incorporates some AI tools in its operations, without saying which. This is a company statement, not independently checked.
ai_news.ai_path: The company itself states it uses AI tools in its operations.

ai_news.title: Monchique water company's smart dispenser was announced as AI-driven in 2021, launch not confirmed
ai_news.summary: Echo Boomer reported that the Nommo Smart Water Pump from Sociedade da Água de Monchique, built with the startup Quantum Leap, would learn household consumption habits and reorder bottles, with sensors checking water quality. It was in pre-production, due on the market in the first half of 2022. We found no report that it launched.
ai_news.ai_path: A Monchique company's product announced with AI that learns habits, so AI is direct, but the launch is unconfirmed.

ai_map.name: Invisible CFO
ai_map.what: Portuguese fintech founded in 2024 and based in Monchique, a digital finance provider for small businesses and freelancers. By its own account it combines AI, automation and a human team, and says 300,000 euros of EU funding helped develop its AI and automation applications. Named an Impact Startup 2025.
ai_map.ai_path: Its product uses AI directly in financial and tax optimisation.

ai_map.name: Incubadora de Empresas de Monchique (IEM)
ai_map.what: The municipal business incubator, listed by the council among its co-financed projects (Vale incubadoras e aceleradoras). It hosts Invisible CFO and says it aims to attract and support companies that settle in Monchique and create jobs.
ai_map.ai_path: It hosts an AI-using startup, so it is the place where an AI company in Monchique would most likely start.

ai_map.name: Sociedade da Água de Monchique (Água Monchique)
ai_map.what: Mineral water producer with its plant at Caldas de Monchique. Its own pages describe a digital strategy, the myMonchique app, a smart water dispenser shown in 2021 and an automated logistics centre. It states it already uses some AI tools, unspecified.
ai_map.ai_path: Company statement that it uses AI tools in its operations, so AI is direct but unspecified and self-reported.

extras.label: Latest council news read
extras.value: The six latest items on the council's news list (3 to 12 November 2026) cover the passage of storm Charles, civil protection notices, a school theatre project, scholarships and cardiac protection. None mentions AI.

extras.label: How fires are detected in Monchique (plan)
extras.value: The municipal forest fire plan (period 2016 to 2020, data to 2015) relies on two lookout posts of the national network, one tower of the AFOCELCA forest industry group and mobile patrols. It describes no video or AI detection.

extras.label: Latest fire in the news
extras.value: 25 July 2026, Vale de Água, Marmelete: alert at 04:58, 98 operatives and 32 vehicles, scrub and eucalyptus, difficult access. The report does not say how it was spotted.

extras.label: The incubator, as the council describes it
extras.value: Individual support to local entrepreneurs and businesses and signposting to funding calls, at the Espaço Jovem next to the Monchique parish council. No tenants are named.

extras.label: Municipal civil protection page
extras.value: The council's civil protection section links to the IPMA weather warning and lists fuel-break and post-fire projects, and describes no detection technology.

extras.label: Fire danger today
extras.value: The council's Perigo de Incêndio Rural page sends readers to IPMA's fire danger map for the Monchique concelho (code 0809). No value is copied here because the page needs a selection to show it and offers no feed.

extras.label: Nearest weather station
extras.value: Fóia, about 4 km from the town centre, with the nearest 5-day forecast place Portimão (about 19 km). The municipality's IPMA code is 0809. Source: IPMA open data as mapped in the conductor's storm local-data brief of 16 November.

gaps: No AI wildfire detection or forest monitoring in Monchique was found. The fire plan we could open (data to 2015) describes human lookout posts, one industry tower and mobile patrols, and the July 2026 fire report names no technology. This is the main gap, since fire is the town's centre of gravity: look for ICNF, ANEPC, the Algarve fire-surveillance network and the University of the Algarve. The national APIS pilots (March 2026) are the closest AI detection work found, and they are in Alvão and Açor, not the Algarve.

None of the council's latest news (3 to 12 November 2026) is about AI, and its site has no RSS feed. Its projects #Algarve mais digital, the business park and Vale incubadoras e aceleradoras are listed without detail we could cite as AI.

Água Monchique's AI claim is its own (a May 2024 post): no tool is named and no independent report confirms it. Its 2021 smart dispenser was announced with AI by Echo Boomer but we found no report of a launch, and the myMonchique app's assistant (Aqua) is described without AI. We should look for an independent source or a named tool.

The council's incubator page names no tenants, so the AI map holds only Invisible CFO. A 2023 plan for six or seven companies and a 2025 industrial park plan suggest more may follow, but we could not read those Sul Informação pieces (the site refused automatic reading).

BRIDGE and InnoBRIDGE (IST, LNEC, UAlg, AGIF) are research on community fire risk with no AI or data tools mentioned, so they are context, not AI map entries. The national 2025 GNR plan for 25 drone cameras names neither AI nor Monchique.
Postal do Algarve, Sul Informação and the RR site refused automatic reading on 15 November (bot checks or 403), so their Monchique stories are not used. A person should read them.
No AI events in Monchique were found. Algarve Evolution has no Monchique member or programme in any source we could open.

The University of the Algarve and its repository (sapientia.ualg.pt) show Monchique fire-risk studies that do not use AI, and we found no AI wildfire work there. Still to look for: the parish councils of Alferce, Marmelete and Monchique, and ANEPC and ICNF pages.

Local media: no radio station or blog for Monchique was found. Jornal de Monchique (a local paper of the association O Monchiqueiro, 30 years old in 2016) may still exist but we could not confirm it. 24 Notícias, Barlavento and Sul Informação cover the town, and none offers a feed we could find. 24 Notícias lists no technology or AI item for Monchique.

Parish councils: the Alferce parish council site (read 2026-11-16) has no digital, AI or fire-monitoring content, only notices, minutes and the storm update. Searches found nothing for Marmelete or the Monchique parish.

Investors, local talent who have spoken publicly and an investment map: nothing public found for Monchique beyond the incubator and Invisible CFO. The incubator's public funding record (the national recovery plan transparency portal) would not load, so no amount is given.

voice.lede: Ó pá, up here on the Serra we have more chestnut trees than data centres, but the medronho is strong and so is the Wi-Fi in the incubator.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Monchique, from the cool of the Serra: AI and technology in a green mountain concelho where the fire worry never sleeps and the little incubator keeps the lights on, plus whatever drifts up from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent, and every fact has its source, ó freguês.
voice.gravity: Monchique lives with the mountain and the mountain lives with fire. The Serra was burned hard in 2018, and the BRIDGE project (IST, LNEC and the University of the Algarve) picked Monchique to learn how neighbours can cut fire risk together. Meanwhile, down at the council incubator, Invisible CFO is minding other people's money with a bit of AI. Not bad for a place famous for ham, honey and hot springs.
voice.gaps_intro: Now the honest part, que se não houver não se inventa: the things we looked for up the Serra and did not find.
